name: job-eagle
description: Guided job search, resume improvement, verified application routes, tailored email drafts, and a simple tracker. Automated email sending is in beta testing and not available yet.

interface.longDescription: Job Eagle guides job seekers through resume creation or improvement, skills discovery, and searches for internships, part-time, full-time, and seasonal roles. Set location, commute, pay, hours, and dates; review researched matches; choose which to pursue; then receive verified contact emails or official application links and personalized outreach drafts. Keep a simple six-column tracker and continue from progress saved through available ChatGPT conversation and file features. Includes an optional quick guide. Automated email sending is in beta testing and not available yet. Users send emails themselves and attach their resume. Job Eagle does not guarantee employment or exhaustive search coverage. Supports searches across countries, including local-language research, relocation preferences, language requirements, and employer-stated sponsorship. Worldwide availability is subject to ChatGPT support and publication settings; work eligibility is assessed separately.
defaultPrompt: Help me start a job search and improve my resume.
Find more jobs using my saved preferences and tracker.
Help me draft outreach for the jobs I selected.

publication.release_notes: Initial Job Eagle release with guided intake, resume help, international job research, verified contacts and application portals, outreach drafts, a six-column tracker, continuation guidance, eagle branding, and public support/privacy/terms pages. Automated email sending is in beta testing and not available yet.

review.commerce_description: Job Eagle is free. No payments, purchases, or paid upgrades are offered by this plugin. ChatGPT access is governed separately by OpenAI.
